card.name: Small words in injection preparation instructions
card.fires_on: Small linking words (be, of, with) in injection preparation text, mainly "be" in "Parenteral drug products should be inspected visually", and "of" or "with" right before a diluent.

modes.label: Inspect visually sentence
modes.description: The word "be" after "Parenteral drug products should" in the standard visual-inspection statement.
modes.example: Administration Parenteral drug products should<< be>> inspected visually for particulate matter and disc

modes.label: Diluent phrasing
modes.description: "of" or "with" just before the name of a diluent in reconstitution or dilution directions.
modes.example: Leucovorin Calcium for Injection should be reconstituted<< with>> Sterile Water for Injection, USP
